Name: Replaces Sebastian with Zane from Aphmau
Author: AJ646
Description:
Just a basic reskin mod that makes Sebastian into Zane. Made this because a friend joked about it with me lol. Requires Content Patcher. Credit to Apollyon as their "Custom Villager Resources" was used for this 

[b]I’m working on revamping the art right now![/b] It’s going to take a bit to update the mod though because I’m generally pretty busy and I haven’t looked into how/if the latest update changes reskins. I’m not even sure if the mod works currently because I’ve taken a break from Stardew valley and hadn’t played with mods on the latest version. I intend on making Zane into a simple custom NPC once Miss Coriel’s NPC creator updates because I missed seeing Sebastian when I last played with the mod lol

[b]7/20/25 Update:[/b] All of the assets are done, I went all out and made seasonal outfits and event specific outfits lol. Now I just need to figure out how to code them into the game!
